sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status table)

values.note: 2026 and 2027: single electric site $41, double electric $81, walk-to tent site $28. One vehicle included; extra vehicles $8 a night. The forest's status table also lists $28/70 (non-electric single/double).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231855/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak: STANDARD ELECTRIC 41, double 81, WALK TO 28) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/west-lake-campground ('Single Site: $28 per night (walk-to), $41 per night (electric) Double Site: $81 per night (electric)') + recreation.gov notice ('Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231855 (all 30 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites 'Electricity Hookup' 15, 22 of them reservable by the public, sites 06-28) + recreation.gov notice ('Sewer and water hookups are not available') + FS page ('All have electricity except for the walk-in sites'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 30 electric RV/tent sites (22 reservable, 29-36 first-come; several doubles) plus 5 walk-to tent sites (1-5); the FS page says 36 sites. Catalog vehicle lengths 30-40 ft, most 30; FS and recreation.gov give parking spurs of 35-80 ft and the forest's status table a 50-ft max spur. Some pull-throughs. Each site has a bear locker.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 231855 (Max Vehicle Length 30-40, Driveway Entry Back-In/Pull-Through, reservable flag) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/west-lake-campground ('There are 36 sites; sites 1-5 are walk-in tent sites', 'The parking length ranges from 35 to 80 feet', 'bear locker') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (West Lake: 35 sites, Max Spur 50'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water until Sept 30; filling RV tanks at the hydrants is not allowed. Firewood sold by the host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231855 ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided'; notice 'Drinking water is available until Sept. 30 each year ... Filling at campground hydrants cross-contaminates the system and is not allowed') + FS page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: West Lake, Operating Season 'May 15 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Sites 06-28 are reservable on recreation.gov up to 4 days before arrival; electric sites 29-36 and the walk-to sites are not reservable (first-come). A reserved site must be occupied within 26 hours of the reservation start or it is let first-come. Dates are recreation.gov's 2027 Peak season (2026: May 15 - Sept 19).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231855 (facility_rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notice 'All campsites must be occupied within 26 hours of the beginning of the reservation. If not present the site will be rented by first come first serve basis.') + campsite catalog (sites 29-36 and 01-05 reservable false; July 2026 availability lists bookings only on 06-28) + /rates (Peak 2027-05-14 to 2027-09-18), read 2026-10-26

note: On the shore of the 25-acre, no-wake West Lake in ponderosa pine near the village of Red Feather Lakes (Canyon Lakes RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF); some sites have less shade since beetle-killed trees were removed. --Claude
summary: FS page (Sept 2026), forest status table, rec.gov facility/rates/catalog: confirmed $41 (2026-27), 15-amp electric (public, bookable sites 06-28), max 40 ft. Count 35 -> 30 (electric sites; 5 walk-to tent sites besides). Added no water/sewer, pull-through, vault toilets, drinking water (to Sept 30), season May 15 - Sept 20 (status table), 4-day cutoff, some_sites FCFS (29-36), booking.season. Pin ~175 m from the per-site centroid. FS page shows 'Site Closed' now (end of season). Note: dropped the count/length/electric/reservable restatements.
flags: Entry phone is empty. Canyon Lakes Ranger District office 970-295-6600 (FS offices page; the same number as the supervisor's office, which shares the building); recreation.gov lists 970-295-6700, and (530) 529-0578 for facility-specific information (concessionaire).

Length conflict: recreation.gov's catalog gives Max Vehicle Length 30-40 ft (most 30); the FS page and recreation.gov description say parking spurs run 35-80 ft; the forest's status table gives Max Spur 50'. Kept 40 (the catalog); every source fits 23 ft.
Site count conflict: FS page 36 sites, status table and catalog 35 (site 13 absent from the catalog).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/west-lake-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
